body.title: Synergistic botanical composition comprising Boswellia serrata and Commiphora mukul for inflammatory joint diseases

sections.heading: Abstract
sections.text: A synergistic anti-arthritic oral composition combining standardized 3-O-acetyl-11-keto-beta-boswellic acid (AKBA >= 30%) with guggulsterones E and Z (>= 2.5%) from Commiphora mukul, significantly inhibiting joint swelling and pro-inflammatory TNF-alpha in adjuvant-induced arthritis models.

claims.text: 1. A synergistic oral botanical composition comprising: (a) a standardized extract of Boswellia serrata resin comprising at least 30.0% by weight of 3-O-acetyl-11-keto-beta-boswellic acid (AKBA); and (b) a standardized extract of Commiphora mukul gum resin comprising at least 2.5% by weight of combined guggulsterones E and Z; in a weight ratio of 2:1 to 4:1.
2. The composition as claimed in claim 1, wherein the combination produces greater than 70% reduction in paw edema in Freund's complete adjuvant arthritis models.
3. The composition as claimed in claim 1, wherein said composition is formulated into hard gelatin capsules.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Under Section 3(e) of the Indian Patents Act, evidence of synergy was submitted demonstrating that AKBA and guggulsterones act on complementary biological targets: 5-LOX inhibition and NF-kappa-B suppression respectively.

cleaned_text:
A synergistic anti-arthritic oral composition combining standardized 3-O-acetyl-11-keto-beta-boswellic acid (AKBA >= 30%) with guggulsterones E and Z (>= 2.5%) from Commiphora mukul, significantly inhibiting joint swelling and pro-inflammatory TNF-alpha in adjuvant-induced arthritis models.

Claim 1: 1. A synergistic oral botanical composition comprising: (a) a standardized extract of Boswellia serrata resin comprising at least 30.0% by weight of 3-O-acetyl-11-keto-beta-boswellic acid (AKBA); and (b) a standardized extract of Commiphora mukul gum resin comprising at least 2.5% by weight of combined guggulsterones E and Z; in a weight ratio of 2:1 to 4:1.

Claim 2: 2. The composition as claimed in claim 1, wherein the combination produces greater than 70% reduction in paw edema in Freund's complete adjuvant arthritis models.

Claim 3: 3. The composition as claimed in claim 1, wherein said composition is formulated into hard gelatin capsules.

Under Section 3(e) of the Indian Patents Act, evidence of synergy was submitted demonstrating that AKBA and guggulsterones act on complementary biological targets: 5-LOX inhibition and NF-kappa-B suppression respectively.
